messages.content: {"problem": "城市热交换简化模型设 f(T)=ln(1+aT+bT^2)，其中 a=-11，b=12。设 p(t)=t+rt^2，定义函数 g(t)，本题具体给定为 g(t)=s·tanh(k(t+rt^2)) 其中 s=-2，k=6，r=4。常用初等函数记号按通常意义理解。记 h(t)=f(g(t)) 并理解为函数复合。任务：求 h(0)、h′(0)、h′′(0)，并讨论在 t 接近 0 时 h(t) 的右侧与左侧的符号、左右侧单调性与在 0 处的凸凹性。为便于统一评估，定义 ask=a*s*k。在 t 接近 0 的小邻域内保证 1+ag(t)+bg(t)^2>0 使 ln 的自变量为正。答案格式说明：按固定字符串格式作答，必须使用如下键与顺序，浮点数保留一位小数。键依次为 h0、h1、h2、sign_right、sign_left、monotonic_left、monotonic_right、凸凹性标签 convexity_at_0、reason。标签取值集合：sign_right 与 sign_left 可取 positive 或 negative 或 zero；monotonic_left 与 monotonic_right 可取 increasing 或 decreasing 或 flat；凸凹性标签 convexity_at_0 可取 convex 或 concave 或 flat；reason 可取 ask>0 或 ask<0 或 h1=0,h2>0 或 h1=0,h2<0 或 h1=h2=0。示例 h0=0.0; h1=0.0; h2=0.0; sign_right=zero; sign_left=zero; monotonic_left=flat; monotonic_right=flat; convexity_at_0=flat; reason=h1=h2=0\n", "canonical_answer": "h0=0.0; h1=132.0; h2=-12912.0; sign_right=positive; sign_left=negative; monotonic_left=increasing; monotonic_right=increasing; convexity_at_0=concave; reason=ask>0", "attempts": [{"panel": 0, "sample": 0, "answer": {"h0": "0.0", "h1": "132.0", "h2": "-12912.0", "sign_right": "positive", "sign_left": "negative", "monotonic_left": "increasing", "monotonic_right": "increasing", "convexity_at_0": "concave", "reason": "ask>0"}, "certificate": "g(0)=0, g'(0)=-12, g''(0)=-96; f'(0)=-11 and f''(0)=2b-a^2=-97. Hence h(0)=0, h'(0)=f'(0)g'(0)=132, and h''(0)=f''(0)(g'(0))^2+f'(0)g''(0)=-97·144+(-11)(-96)=-12912. Since h'(0)>0, h is increasing on both sufficiently small one-sided neighborhoods; h(t) has the sign of t. Since h''(0)<0, it is concave at 0. Also ask=(-11)(-2)(6)=132>0."}]}
